biography: John Greenwood's racing journey began not on a manicured track, but on the dusty backroads of rural Mississippi, where he honed his skills driving his grandfather's battered pickup truck. His natural talent was evident early on, catching the eye of a local mechanic who sponsored his entry into a regional karting series. It was there, amidst the roaring engines and the smell of burning rubber, that Greenwood found his true calling. A defining moment came at the age of 18, when he won the prestigious 'Dixie Cup' karting championship, beating seasoned veterans and earning a scholarship to a racing academy. He quickly transitioned to stock car racing, impressing Chevrolet scouts with his calm demeanor and consistent lap times. Now, at 23, Greenwood is a rising star in the Chevrolet racing program, steadily climbing the ranks and aiming for the top echelon of motorsport. His grounded nature and unwavering focus make him a formidable competitor, and he's dedicated to honoring his family's sacrifices with every race.
drivingStyle: Greenwood's driving style is characterized by a remarkable consistency and calculated aggression. He's not one for flashy overtakes or risky maneuvers; instead, he patiently studies his opponents, identifies their weaknesses, and exploits them with precision. Greenwood excels at tire management, nursing his rubber through long stints and maintaining a steady pace even under immense pressure. He approaches each corner with a methodical approach, prioritizing corner exit speed over entry exuberance. This calm and collected style allows him to consistently deliver solid results, making him a reliable asset to the Chevrolet team.
